name: Player Rig
description: A nameplate and a health bar that follow every avatar — the Multiplayer Server owns the hit points.

changelog.notes: The gun's damage and rate now come only from Game Config (weapons.gunDamage, weapons.fireRate) — the shotDamage and shotsPerSecond params are gone, because the server derived the numbers from the table and ignored them. Update a placed copy so its script settings line up again.

Initial release: one rig per player with a nameplate and health bar that follow the avatar, a right-hand anchor for held items, hit points the server owns, and a gun script that reports its hits for the server to check
